deliverables: Part-time maintainer for Oura over 12 months
Dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation
Issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback-driven enhancements, and public developer communication
Milestone-based disbursement controls and reporting obligations
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Oura by TxPipe maintenance over 12 months, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee.
The motivation states the underlying maintenance request is 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve to fund a part-time maintainer at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
Oura is described as a Rust-native pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.

The proposal says Oura supports multiple sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC and many sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The proposal states Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and links to the public GitHub repository.
The proposal claims Oura is used across the ecosystem for indexing, monitoring, analytics, and real-time event processing.
The proposal states Oura was previously funded through Project Catalyst Funds 9 and 13 for feature development.
The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
The proposal claims it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation and results.
The proposal states the withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission and links to the governance action for that limit.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Oura maintenance under Intersect administration, presenting Oura as open-source Cardano event-pipeline infrastructure with stated public repository metrics, broad technical integration scope, prior funding history, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based oversight.
